thread:
Mozilla just shipped 312 Firefox patches from Claude Mythos findings.

Six months ago, AI-generated security reports were known for being slop.

Here's what changed:

The numbers:
• 27M lines analyzed
• 1,847 issues flagged
• 387 real vulnerabilities (21% precision)
• 312 fixes shipped to production

79% false positive rate — but the 21% catches bugs that take weeks of manual review.

The pattern Mozilla used:

1. Claude Mythos generates security candidates
2. Security engineers validate
3. Firefox team patches

This is the agentic security pipeline we're deploying for VioX OS clients now.

Jordan's Chief of Staff agent — the one handling sales pipeline orchestration for a 47-person team — went through 3 agentic security passes before we cut over to production.

DreamersJoy's Voice agent went through 4 because it touches PII.

The security model just changed.

If you're shipping agents that touch customer data, you need agentic code review in your pipeline this week.
